method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks struggle on Nvidia whiplash, dollar climbs with US yields
Equities.reason: Representative market-open headline tying Nvidia leadership shock to broader equity weakness and higher yields/dollar — signals a risk-off impulse across indices driven by the AI bellwether.

Equities.title: Equities close lower as Nvidia drop outweighs energy gains
Equities.reason: Closing-market take that Nvidia’s fall is the dominant driver of equity weakness despite sectoral offsets (energy) — reinforces negative broad-market narrative and index downside.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall on Nvidia Rout as Oil Jump Sinks Bonds: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Cross-asset wrap linking Nvidia-led equity selling with commodity/bond moves — highlights market contagion from the Nvidia shock into broader risk and rates-sensitive positioning.

Equities.title: Nvidia’s turmoil is prompting a rotation across chip stocks. Here's what we know
Equities.summary: That shift comes as Nvidia grapples with the fallout from Huang's resignation, following revelations about his multiple affairs.
Equities.reason: Sector-level nuance: while Nvidia is the epicentre of pain, investors are rotating into other chip names — implies dispersion and selective buying amid headline-driven volatility rather than uniform market collapse.

Equities.title: Nvidia Weighs on US Index Futures as CEO Uncertainty Hits Shares
Equities.reason: Futures-market signal that uncertainty around Nvidia leadership is directly depressing index futures — underlines systemic index risk from a single mega-cap in the AI leadership theme.

Equities.title: US lawmakers pile pressure on Lutnick as Nvidia scandal widens
Equities.summary: Legislators demand commerce secretary explain why he allowed chip sales to company linked to alleged Chinese spy
Equities.reason: Political and regulatory escalation broadens the narrative from reputational/operational risk at Nvidia to potential policy and export-control implications for the chip industry — adds medium-term downside risk premium.

Equities.title: Anthropic’s IPO Is About Six Times Oversubscribed
Equities.reason: Countervailing evidence of continued investor appetite for AI exposure via IPO demand — tempers the view that the Nvidia shock destroys broader AI financing/interest.

Equities.title: Cerebras surges 17% after beating on quarterly revenue and announcing Microsoft deal
Equities.summary: Cerebras announced a new deal with Microsoft after partnering with major cloud providers Amazon and Oracle.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic positive showing beneficiaries of AI hardware demand — supports a rotation narrative where non-Nvidia AI plays can outperform amid the turmoil.

Equities.title: Chinese AI sell-off deepens over fears of tougher Nvidia chip restrictions
Equities.summary: Ousted chief executive Jensen Huang had supported keeping sales open to China
Equities.reason: Shows regional spillovers: concerns about US export curbs and Nvidia governance are amplifying sell-offs in Chinese AI-related equities — increases global equity downside risk tied to policy uncertainty.

Rates.title: Treasury Yield Surge Shatters Hopes Worst of Bond Rout Is Over
Rates.reason: Headline indicates a renewed, significant rise in Treasury yields and extension of a bond rout — clearly negative for bond prices and market-wide rates sentiment; market-moving, hence high relevance.

Rates.title: Japan Bonds Fall as Treasury Rout Extends on Fed-Hike Bets
Rates.reason: Japanese government bonds sold off in sympathy with US Treasury moves as Fed-hike bets rise — negative for bond prices, regional manifestation of global yield uptrend; medium-high relevance.

Rates.title: China Policy Bank Bonds Suffer Selloff as Tax Worries Hit Market
Rates.reason: Local selloff in China policy bank bonds signals credit/technical stress and rising local yields — negative for that bond market and contributes to broader rates risk-off.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Stronger case for higher US Dollar rates – RBC Economics
Rates.summary: RBC Economics argues the case for higher Federal Reserve (Fed) rates is stronger than for the Bank of Canada (BoC), citing rising US core inflation, robust Q3 GDP and a historically tight labour market.
Rates.reason: Analyst view that Fed rates should be higher strengthens expectations for further Fed hiking — negative for bond prices (higher-for-longer yields); feeds the global rates narrative.

Rates.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE has raised Bank Rate to 4% — directly signals tighter policy and higher local yields, negative for UK fixed income and supportive of a higher-for-longer global rates backdrop.

Rates.title: Top Pension Fund to Buy More India State Bonds on High Yields
Rates.reason: Institutional buying of local bonds in response to high yields is a demand-side stabilizer for that market — modestly positive for local bond prices and offsets some selloff pressure.

Rates.title: Peru Lifts Interest Rate for First Time in Nearly Four Years
Rates.reason: A local central bank hike tightens policy and lifts domestic yields — negative for local bonds but limited global rates impact; hence low relevance.

Rates.title: Shrinking BDCs Keep Private Credit on Sidelines as Rates Rise
Rates.reason: Private credit activity being damped by rising rates highlights broader credit market stress and higher-for-longer rate effects — negative for credit and overall fixed-income conditions.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar holds ground despite lower oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD moves little after two days of gains, trading around 1.4250 during Asian hours on Friday. However, the pair may appreciate as the US Dollar (USD) could receive support from persistent inflation concerns and expectations of higher interest rates.
FX.reason: USD support from persistent US inflation and hawkish rate expectations is the main driver for USD/CAD; lower oil removes a tailwind for CAD, leaving the dollar-biased narrative intact.

FX.title: United States: Growth and labour momentum support US Dollar – RBC Economics
FX.summary: RBC Economics notes that U.S. growth and labour-market momentum remain strong, with GDP forecasts revised higher to an average of 2.4% in 2026–2027 and unemployment expected near historical lows at 4.2%. Rising core inflation and producer-price data suggest bu
FX.reason: Macro bank call highlighting stronger growth, tight labour market and sticky inflation increases likelihood of Fed tightening — reinforces broad USD strength narrative.

FX.title: United States Dollar: Supported into year-end before later softening – National Bank of Canada
FX.summary: National Bank of Canada strategists Stéfane Marion and Kyle Dahms note that the Dollar remains underpinned by persistent U.S. inflation and expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening.
FX.reason: Strategy note flags near-term dollar support from persistent US inflation and Fed tightening expectations — supports near-term USD-positive bias for FX markets.

FX.title: US Dollar Index (DXY) sits near April 2025 highs, above 10.300 on Fed bets and Iran risks
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, enters a bullish consolidation phase on Friday as bulls pause for a breather following a strong three-day rally to the highest level since April 2025, touched the previous da
FX.reason: Broad DXY strength on renewed Fed-hike bets and geopolitical (Iran) risk is a market-wide driver — large negative transmission for non-USD currencies in the FX basket.

FX.title: Dollar near 19-month high on Fed hike bets, yen tests 160
FX.reason: High-quality wire confirms dollar at multi‑month highs driven by Fed-hike expectations and yen weakness toward intervention levels — reinforces dominant USD-strength regime.

FX.title: Japan’s Takaichi says in close contact with US financial authorities on currency market
FX.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said on Friday that the government is in close contact with US financial authorities on the currency market. She further stated that the officials will strive to preserve an orderly foreign exchange market.
FX.reason: Official comments about close contact with US authorities indicate elevated intervention risk to defend the yen as USD strength pushes USD/JPY toward policy-sensitive levels — market‑moving for JPY and broader FX flows.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Softens below 0.6800, maintaining bearish technical outlook
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair extends the decline to near 0.6785 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Growing bets of a half-point Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).
FX.reason: Technical price-forecast piece (limited relevance) noting USD support from Fed hike bets that is pressuring AUD — reinforces USD-positive / commodity‑currency weakness theme.

FX.title: Indian Rupee falls further amid fears of Fed's aggressive tightening cycle
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its previous day’s correction against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday after rallying in the past few weeks.
FX.reason: INR weakness tied directly to USD outperformance and fears of aggressive Fed tightening — typical EM reaction to a stronger dollar and higher global yields.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains on easing political uncertainty despite MSCI outflow risks
FX.summary: USD/IDR pulls back after reaching a record high of 18,285 in the previous day, trading around 18,220 during Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Local political easing supports IDR and pulls USD/IDR lower — a localized counter‑signal to the broader dollar rally but limited relevance to the global USD regime.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Posts mild gains above 1.1050, while staying capped below 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades with mild gains near 1.1060 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Nonetheless, the potential upside for the major pair might be limited amid a cautious stance from the European Central Bank (ECB).
FX.reason: Technical/strategy note showing modest EUR bids but ECB caution caps upside — small local EUR-positive signal, but overshadowed by dominant dollar/ Fed narrative.

Commodities.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
Commodities.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields
Commodities.reason: Higher distillate margins and yield shifts tighten diesel/jet markets and support refined-product and crude prices; fundamental, regional refinery-driven impact on product spreads.

Commodities.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
Commodities.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million
Commodities.reason: Large, conflict-related decline in global throughput is a material supply-side tightening for refined products and crude demand patterns — broad macro/market-moving oil implication.

Commodities.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
Commodities.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in
Commodities.reason: Medium-term supply increase from Alaska projects is bearish for crude but modest relative to global flows — moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
Commodities.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
Commodities.reason: Resumption/upswing in Venezuelan flows into the U.S. increases available supply and is a modest headwind to nearby crude prices.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Nearby Gulf storm-driven production and infrastructure shut-ins create short-term physical tightness — clear positive price impulse for crude and gas.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bears have the upper hand below 23.6% Fibo. and 200-hour SMA
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – edges lower during the Asian session on Friday, though it lacks follow-through as traders await further developments surrounding the Middle East crisis.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece — short-term bearish signal but low relevance for structural commodity view (relevance capped per framework).

Commodities.title: Oil-Hungry Asia Turns Back to Mideast in Earnest as Flows Expand
Commodities.reason: Rising Asia demand for Middle East crude increases crude flows and supports prices — important regional demand-side signal reinforcing bullish oil narrative.

Commodities.title: Oil Supertanker Squeeze Is Crimping US Crude Exports, Texas Port CEO Says
Commodities.reason: Logistical tanker constraints limiting US export capacity effectively tighten global available crude supply — meaningful near-term bullish factor.

Commodities.title: A Shortage of Ore is Causing a Pricing Revolution in Copper
Commodities.reason: Fundamental ore shortage signals structurally tighter copper market and materially bullish price impulse for industrial metals — high relevance for copper.

Commodities.title: Silver Market Set for Deficit Even as Solar Makers Cut Back
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg fundamental piece pointing to a silver supply deficit is a meaningful bullish driver for silver prices, outweighing short-term demand cuts in solar.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls back below $50 amid mayhem in US bond markets
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gives up its slight early gains and falls back below $50.00 during the European trading session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Short-term technical/flow-driven drop linked to bond-market volatility; low-to-moderate relevance (price-forecast piece).

Commodities.title: Gold rises on bargain hunting but heads for weekly decline
Commodities.reason: Gold showing short-term bargain hunting but capped by Fed hike expectations; slightly negative bias for bullion given rate-driven headwinds, moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs are now down over $1.5 billion in net outflows for the year
Crypto.reason: Sustained ETF net outflows represent a pullback in institutional demand and are a clear near-term negative for BTC price and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps below $72,000 as Nvidia's Huang resigns, interest rates surge
Crypto.reason: Macro shock (rates surge) and correlated tech selloff drove broad risk-off; higher yields and risk aversion are strongly negative for crypto assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
Crypto.reason: Counterparty/solvency stress at a crypto firm raises contagion and custody concerns — a material negative for market confidence and flows.

Crypto.title: Canaan may sell more bitcoin for stock buybacks as mining-rig revenue falls 96%
Crypto.reason: Miners selling BTC to shore up balance sheets or for buybacks increases supply pressure at a time of weaker demand — negative for BTC price.

Crypto.title: North Korea's Binance hack faces U.S. crackdown as DOJ targets $1.2 billion in stolen crypto
Crypto.reason: Large-scale hack enforcement highlights persistent security/AML risks; while recovery efforts help, the headline reinforces negative narratives around crypto crime and regulatory scrutiny.

Crypto.title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
Crypto.reason: DTCC adoption of Solana for tokenization is a high‑quality institutional demand signal that materially improves Solana's fundamentals and broader institutional crypto adoption.

Crypto.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin integration and expanded liquidity on a major Solana lending platform supports on‑chain credit markets and token utility — positive for Solana ecosystem.

Crypto.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
Crypto.reason: Industry pushback against an onerous state crypto tax could limit new tax burdens and regulatory costs if successful — modestly positive for the industry pending legal outcome.

Crypto.title: U.S. President Trump names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
Crypto.reason: Progress on regulatory appointments reduces policy uncertainty marginally; directional impact depends on nominee stances, so relevance and directional conviction are low.

Crypto.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
Crypto.reason: Treasury-level ETH sales to manage DeFi loan health reveals leverage/liquidity stress in the ETH ecosystem and is a price-negative near term.

Crypto.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks put 30,000 bitcoin back in focus
Crypto.reason: Speculative corporate M&A talk potentially reintroduces a sizable corporate BTC holding into the market narrative — positive for demand but low probability and speculative.

Crypto.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
Crypto.reason: Technical upgrades aimed at quantum resistance improve long‑term security and institutional viability for Ethereum, but are low‑signal for immediate market moves.
